name: tjs-syntax-check
description: Reports TJS2 syntax errors from tjscheck in the editor. Highlighting comes from the TJS language extension, which this one adds to rather than replaces.

tjscheck.checkerPath.description: Path to tjscheck.exe. Empty looks beside the extension, then one level up for a build of this repository, then on PATH.

tjscheck.debounceMs.description: How long to wait after typing stops before checking.
